## getMy

Get My Signature. `GET /email-signatures/me`

Get the current user's email signature.

Returns 404 if the user hasn't created a signature yet. Use POST /email-signatures/me/copy-from-template to initialize from the tenant template.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailSignatures()->getMy();
```

- Scopes: `email_signatures:read`

Returns `UserSignature`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Signatures/get_my_signature_api_v1_email_signatures_me_get)

## updateMy

Update My Signature. `PUT /email-signatures/me`

Create or update the current user's email signature.

The signature HTML can include placeholders which will be resolved when emails are sent. However, users typically personalize the signature with their actual values.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailSignatures()->updateMy(contentHtml: 'content_html');
```

- Scopes: `email_signatures:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$contentHtml` | `string` | yes | HTML content of the personalized signature |
| `$contentText` | `?string` | no | Plain text version for non-HTML emails |
| `$isActive` | `?bool` | no | Whether the signature is active. When False, effective-signature resolution will skip this user signature (and the auto-insert effect in the composer will not pre-fill it). Optional on PUT — omitting it leaves the existing flag unchanged. |

Returns `UserSignature`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Signatures/update_my_signature_api_v1_email_signatures_me_put)

## copyTemplateToMy

Copy Template To My Signature. `POST /email-signatures/me/copy-from-template`

Copy the tenant's signature template to the current user's signature.

This creates a personalized copy of the tenant template that the user can then customize. The template's placeholders are copied as-is and will be resolved when emails are sent.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailSignatures()->copyTemplateToMy();
```

- Scopes: `email_signatures:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `UserSignature`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Signatures/copy_template_to_my_signature_api_v1_email_signatures_me_copy_from_template_post)

## getEffective

Get Effective Signature. `GET /email-signatures/me/effective`

Get the fully resolved signature for the current user.

Returns the user's signature (if exists) or falls back to tenant template, with all placeholders resolved to actual values.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailSignatures()->getEffective();
```

- Scopes: `email_signatures:read`

Returns `EffectiveSignature`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Signatures/get_effective_signature_api_v1_email_signatures_me_effective_get)

## getTenantTemplate

Get Tenant Template. `GET /email-signatures/template`

Get the tenant's email signature template.

Returns the tenant-wide signature template with placeholders. Returns 404 if no template has been created yet.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailSignatures()->getTenantTemplate();
```

- Scopes: `email_signatures:read`

Returns `SignatureTemplate`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Signatures/get_tenant_template_api_v1_email_signatures_template_get)

## updateTenantTemplate

Update Tenant Template. `PUT /email-signatures/template`

Create or update the tenant's signature template.

This template serves as the master/default signature for the tenant. Agents can copy this template to customize their own signatures.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailSignatures()->updateTenantTemplate(contentHtml: 'content_html');
```

- Scopes: `email_signatures:settings`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$contentHtml` | `string` | yes | HTML content of the signature template with placeholders |
| `$contentText` | `?string` | no | Plain text version for non-HTML emails |

Returns `SignatureTemplate`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Signatures/update_tenant_template_api_v1_email_signatures_template_put)
